initial_observed_findings.note: Major instance count includes repeated unlabeled-control occurrences; it is not 117 distinct design decisions.

root_findings.summary: Nonlinear Brush Size exposed internal track coordinate instead of the real px value.
Atlas navigation disappeared at narrow widths, making non-Numbers pages unreachable.
Segmented choices, switches, swatches and anchor grid did not consistently expose their selection/state semantics.
Many visible inputs and visual-only buttons lacked accessible names or persistent labels.
Gradient placement, crop placement and workspace splitter sizing lacked a complete non-drag pointer route in the standard.
Color peer pages and Atlas category pages needed an explicit tabs contract.
The original translucent focus outline was too weak against light surfaces.

repairs: N2 custom semantic slider now exposes actual Brush Size min/max/current/value text in px; internal nonlinear coordinate is hidden from semantics.
Narrow navigation becomes a reachable horizontal tab list instead of disappearing.
Exclusive segmented choices, swatches and anchor cells use radio-group semantics; switch and toggle-button states are explicit and synchronized.
Inputs, visual swatches, anchors, reorder controls, link controls and search receive persistent/accessibility names.
Gradient, crop and workspace resize standards now include non-drag single-pointer alternatives in addition to keyboard alternatives.
Color peer pages and Atlas categories use tab semantics with roving focus and selected/focus separation.
Focus outline changed to solid #756DF5 at 3px; measured contrast is ~3.99:1 on white and ~3.78:1 on #F7F9FC.
Shortcut capture now has explicit recording/cancel semantics; reorder commands work without drag and preserve focus.
Numeric validation/unavailable-state and custom-control implementation contracts were added to the standard.
Coarse-pointer rules enlarge effective targets; final 320px coarse-pointer scan found no visible button/input/select target below 24×24 CSS px.

standalone_browser_runtime.engine: Chromium headless / exact current Atlas bytes via page.set_content

shortcut.recording_label: Recording keyboard shortcut. Press a key combination, or Escape to cancel.

verified_here: Semantic pattern selection against UI Implementation Quality engine for relative numeric, precision numeric, boolean, small exclusive choice, and searchable large choice.
Static accessible-name/state/tab/radio/switch/N2 semantic-value checks defined for this Atlas.
Standalone Chromium interaction tests for N2 keyboard adjustment, tabs, radio groups, switch, non-drag reorder, shortcut capture/cancel, focus style.
Responsive page reachability and horizontal overflow at 1440, 1024, 720, 480 and 320 CSS px widths.
Coarse-pointer target scan at 320 CSS px width.
Synthetic computed-font-size ×2 stress at 1440 and 320 widths.
unverified: Representative real assistive-technology operation (NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack).
Touch assistive-technology behavior for custom slider/direct editors.
Real pen/stylus behavior and pen/touch arbitration.
Virtual-keyboard occlusion and final Compact production layout.
Native platform text-scaling/zoom behavior beyond the browser synthetic stress.
Production application integration, history transactions, live-preview performance and latency.
Final product ranges, steps and nonlinear calibration that require brush/device testing.
conclusion: The semantic standard and standalone Atlas defects found by this audit were repaired and regression-checked. Full UI/production PASS is not claimed because device/AT/application integration gates remain unverified.
